title: Protected live CRUD, end to end

competitor.concept: useQuery — a reactive React hook that subscribes to a query function and automatically re-renders when the underlying data changes; the query function itself typically calls ctx.auth.getUserIdentity() and filters with .filter()/.withIndex() by the caller's identity to scope results per-user.

Row Level Security (RLS) policies on a Postgres table, combined with supabase-js's realtime subscription, so a `select` (or a `.on('postgres_changes', ...)` subscription) only ever returns rows the policy predicate (typically `auth.uid() = owner_id`) allows for the current session's JWT.
